svg.title: TrinityMatrix production architecture
svg.desc: Browser clients connect through Nginx to a single authoritative Fastify application. Redis, PostgreSQL and the delayed FFmpeg media worker are private services. OpenRouter and Resend are external integrations. Explicit operator jobs handle migrations, qualification and synthetic agent practice.
